discovery_corpus_census.method: sqlite3 database/local_operation_discovery_corpus.db run directly against candidate_families, not read from any prior document.

attribution_state_breakdown.ATTRIBUTABLE: subset of 385, distinct dimension from classification
attribution_state_breakdown.NON_ATTRIBUTIVE_PROVENANCE: subset of 385, distinct dimension from classification

discovery_corpus_census.strong_and_attributable_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_families WHERE classification='STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY' AND attribution_state='ATTRIBUTABLE' -> 8 (measured live)
discovery_corpus_census.verdict: The task brief's '385 total candidate families' figure is CONFIRMED against live data.

phase_e_deterministic_classification_rul.source: src/discovery/local_operation_discovery_projection.py, _classify_family() (lines ~226-246), read directly -- deterministic, interpretable rule-based, no ML/scoring involved.
rule_logic_summary: STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY: highest member_count/creator_count with repeat-amount or fanout signal (exact numeric thresholds live in source; implementers call _classify_family directly rather than re-deriving thresholds here, to avoid drift).
AMBIGUOUS_FUNDING_CLUSTER / SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_CLUSTER / NOISE_OR_INSUFFICIENT: remaining buckets for mega-hub, self-loop-upstream, or below-threshold populations.
phase_e_deterministic_classification_rul.policy: No automatic promotion exists anywhere in this classification path -- _classify_family() only assigns a label into candidate_families.classification; it never writes to operators.status or calls any promotion/governance service.

eligible_for_analyst_intake_queue.condition: classification IN ('STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY', 'PARTIAL_CANDIDATE_FAMILY') AND family_id is not already DISMISSED in wt_investigation_lifecycle
eligible_for_analyst_intake_queue.note: Reuses the exact classification boundary the codebase's own cross-family pairing query already applies (local_operation_discovery_projection.py lines ~369-371: WHERE f1.classification IN ('STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY','PARTIAL_CANDIDATE_FAMILY') AND f2.classification IN (...)).

strict_tier_STRONG_and_ATTRIBUTABLE.condition: classification = 'STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY' AND attribution_state = 'ATTRIBUTABLE' AND family_id is not already DISMISSED in wt_investigation_lifecycle
strict_tier_STRONG_and_ATTRIBUTABLE.note: A tighter default-queue view within the broader eligible set above, adding the independent attribution_state dimension to exclude CEX/infra-terminating provenance from the DEFAULT queue (not from evidence).

phase_e_intake_eligibility_criteria.eligible_condition: classification = 'STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY' AND attribution_state = 'ATTRIBUTABLE' AND family_id is not already DISMISSED in wt_investigation_lifecycle
phase_e_intake_eligibility_criteria.rationale: Tightened to the STRONG x ATTRIBUTABLE intersection (8 of 385) rather than STRONG-or-PARTIAL alone: attribution_state is an independent, already-existing schema dimension (root_cex_infra_category / cex_infra_hop_distance derived) distinguishing families with an attributable non-CEX-only funding path from ones whose provenance terminates at CEX/infra. Requiring BOTH avoids queuing high-member-count families whose only evidence is proximity to shared platform infrastructure (SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_CLUSTER-adjacent risk).

broader_context_tier.usage: Visible in the discovery feed as background/context, not auto-queued for analyst review by default; an analyst can still promote any one of these into the queue manually.

excluded_by_design.AMBIGUOUS_FUNDING_CLUSTER: 100 -- held as context/background, visible in discovery feed but not queued for analyst review by default.
excluded_by_design.SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_CLUSTER: 8 -- explicitly a platform/service-routing pattern, not an operator candidate (matches ops_tokens.html cexchip 'shared launch platform, not one operator' semantics).
excluded_by_design.NOISE_OR_INSUFFICIENT: 175 -- below evidentiary threshold, excluded from default queue view.
excluded_by_design.NON_ATTRIBUTIVE_PROVENANCE: families whose attribution_state is NON_ATTRIBUTIVE_PROVENANCE are excluded from the default intake queue VIEW only; this evidence is not excluded from evidence, never deleted, and remains visible in the family's own detail record and in the broader-context tier above.

stages: ELIGIBILITY_FILTER (STRONG x ATTRIBUTABLE = 8, or broader context tier = 102)
proposed_intake_flow.note: Every arrow in this funnel requires an explicit human POST action through the existing operator_routes.py / operator_identity_governance.py endpoints. No stage writes operators.status automatically.

phase_f_analyst_queue_reuse_decision.question: Can the existing Analyst Queue mechanism absorb new discovery candidates cleanly?
phase_f_analyst_queue_reuse_decision.finding: YES -- reuse, do not build a second workflow.
phase_f_analyst_queue_reuse_decision.mechanism_chosen: InvestigationLifecycleService (src/ops/investigation_lifecycle.py) is already family_id-keyed (the discovery corpus's own primary key unit), already has a DISMISSED/REOPENED state machine with full audit trail (wt_investigation_lifecycle + wt_investigation_lifecycle_audit), and already computes a behaviour_snapshot()/fingerprint() over exactly the kind of fields discovery families carry (treasuries, clients, mechanisms, topologies, walkback_descendants, supporting_types). New discovery-corpus families slot into this table using their existing family_id with zero schema change.
phase_f_analyst_queue_reuse_decision.why_not_a_second_workflow: A second workflow would (a) duplicate the DISMISS/REOPEN state machine, (b) create two places an analyst could act on the same family_id, (c) violate the Phase T architecture principle (ONE investigation workflow). Absolutely prohibited per task brief ('DO NOT build a competing operations registry').
phase_f_analyst_queue_reuse_decision.gap_identified: InvestigationLifecycleService currently reads/writes against family_id values produced by the LIVE discovery pipeline (src/discovery/service.py), not yet against the local_operation_discovery_corpus.db candidate_families table specifically. Wiring the corpus DB's family_id namespace into the same lifecycle table is a small, additive, read-adjacent change (a new read adapter, not a schema change) -- left design-only this milestone, see implementation_result artifact.

source_badge_concepts_designed.NEW_DISCOVERY: family present in local_operation_discovery_corpus.db, not yet linked to any operator_id or main-DB historical population.
source_badge_concepts_designed.MAIN_DB: relationship present in creator_funders (historical, pre-existing), independent of discovery corpus.
source_badge_concepts_designed.EVIDENCE_UPGRADE: a historical (MAIN_DB) relationship whose discovery-corpus classification is STRONG/PARTIAL (i.e. the 23/82 split concept generalized) -- evidence quality moved up without changing membership.
source_badge_concepts_designed.RAW_VERIFIED: relationship has an entry in a raw-verification ledger (of_dv34_p1_selective_raw_verification_result.json pattern) with an explicit VERIFIED/CONTRADICTED/NOT_PERFORMED outcome.
source_badge_concepts_designed.PROVISIONER: entity classified as a funding provisioner (wrap-close / repeated structural provisioning) without independently established operation identity -- see role_taxonomy below.
source_badge_concepts_designed.CEX_CONTEXT: entity or funding hop attributed to a CEX/infra category (root_cex_infra_category populated) -- shown as context, never as sole attribution.

role_taxonomy.note: FUNDING_STRUCTURE is the neutral base classification for a recurring funding relationship. It does not establish common operation identity or any specific entity role. An entity role may later be independently established; OPERATION_CANDIDATE requires multiple independent operational signals; CONFIRMED_OPERATION retains the existing human-review authority gate.

intake_funnel_summary.downstream_of_queue: Human review via existing operator_routes.py POST endpoints -> at most PROVISIONAL/REVIEW_CANDIDATE status -> further human action required to reach CONFIRMED. No stage in this funnel is automatic.

assumptions_and_judgment_calls: Chose the STRONG_CANDIDATE_FAMILY x ATTRIBUTABLE intersection (8) as the STRICT default intake queue, and STRONG+PARTIAL (102) as a secondary context tier, rather than a single threshold -- this reuses two already-existing schema dimensions (classification, attribution_state) instead of inventing a new composite score.
The corpus-DB-to-investigation-lifecycle wiring gap is real and is called out explicitly rather than assumed solved; see implementation_result.json for disposition.
